habitat: Grassy places with grasses, sedges or shrubs near streams, rivers or lakes.
summary: Newman's Birds has no page for this species, and the Wikipedia account does not describe the plumage, voice or length. It lives in grassy vegetation near water. Avibase lists Fan-tailed Grassbird and marks it rare, so the months are left unset. The Kemp name Broadtailed Warbler and the code VB were left unchanged.

viewNotes.note: The plumage is not described in the sources used.
The underside in flight is not described.

calls.description: The sources used do not describe the voice. No South African grade A recording was found. The grade A call is from Nyonié in Gabon. The filename is XC930050-Mégalure-à-bec-court-cris.mp3.

research.note: Newman's Birds has no page. Wikipedia gives the habitat and does not describe plumage, voice or length, so those are left unset and no colours are taken from the photograph. Avibase marks it rare, so the months are left unset. The status is kept as resident because it is an African species and the months of any movement are not given. The grade A call is from Gabon. The Kemp name Broadtailed Warbler and the code VB were left unchanged.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^6=64 mature individuals (visiting breeder); paper interval half–double → 32–128.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.
